title: Cummins R2.8 H151 Swap into 1993 FZJ80
ai_summary: Builder installed a new Cummins R2.8 crate engine into a 1993 FZJ80 mated to the factory H151 5-speed with a custom 3-inch adapter ring, explicitly avoiding any frame cutting/welding. The factory transfer case was retained. R2.8 is rated 161 hp / 310 lb-ft stock.

complications.detail: R2.8 cannot sit as far back as the original 1FZ due to firewall indentation/EGR assembly, requiring a thick custom adapter ring and reworked oil pan sump placement
H151 installation required cutting, fabricating, and welding the transmission tunnel floor
Gasoline fuel lines/tank pickup were incompatible; diesel lines and pickup assembly had to be sourced from a Japan-market 4x4 and the filler pipe required a body lift to remove
